conventionsSummary.configDriven: The system aims to be config-driven: values, models, and strings should come from config/ registry, not hardcoded. Evidence: provider registry, providerModels.js, runtimeConfig.js, translator pipeline through OpenAI format.
conventionsSummary.drY: Don't Repeat Yourself: Shared logic in concerns/, formats/, schema/. Translators self-register via register().
conventionsSummary.noHardcode: NEVER hardcode values, models, or block/role strings — use config/ + schema/ constants. (open-sse/AGENTS.md)
conventionsSummary.testImportAliases: @/ alias must resolve from vitest config; otherwise use relative paths
